pageDescription: Buttons trigger actions and navigate users through tasks. Use the design tab to inspect anatomy, spacing, and interactive states.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: A standard button is built from a container, optional leading icon, label text, and optional trailing icon.

parts.label: Container
parts.description: Defines hit area, background, border, and corner radius.

parts.label: Label
parts.description: Action text using base text style (Inter, 16px / 24px line height on medium size).

parts.label: Icon (optional)
parts.description: Font Awesome glyph aligned to the label; icon-only buttons omit the label.

specification.title: Specification guidelines
specification.description: Inspect default padding and control height on the primary button. Values update when you change size in Button types below.

types.title: Button types
types.description: Configure size, then hover or press each variant to preview interaction states.

guidelines.title: Guideline
guidelines.description: Buttons should clearly communicate the outcome of an action and use hierarchy to show importance.

rows: Use a primary button for the single leading action on a view.
Place two primary buttons side by side for competing actions.
Use sentence case for labels (e.g. Save changes).
Use vague labels such as OK or Submit without context.
Disable a button when the action is unavailable; keep it visible when possible.
Hide the primary action entirely when validation fails without explanation.

items.heading: Primary
items.body: Primary buttons are for the leading action on a page, panel, or modal. There should be at most one primary button per action area.

items.heading: Secondary
items.body: Secondary buttons support alternate actions that are still important, such as Cancel alongside Save.

items.heading: Tertiary
items.body: Tertiary buttons are for low-emphasis actions in dense toolbars or repeated lists.

items.heading: Button link
items.body: Use link buttons for inline, text-first actions where a filled or outlined button would overpower the layout.
